name: LocalTrader LCTExchange missing access control
summary: The closed-source LCTExchange exposes a privileged transfer/settlement entry point without an owner check, so the attacker called it directly and moved the exchange's BNB and LCT out.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history were imported from the seed inventory without independent review.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: LCTExchange 0xcE3e12bD77DD54E20a18cB1B94667F3E697bea06 created 2023-05-11T10:36:27Z by 0xdc02a3b51d86d7a19ad24082c0c82affe8412913, unrelated to attack sender 0xd771dfa8fa59bd2d1251a0481fca0cf216276dd7; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (LocalTrader_exp and LocalTrader2_exp) for the same four-transaction incident; one row is recorded. lossUsd converts the 384 BNB reported: 384 BNB x $313.66 at incidentTimestamp 1684841942 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $120,445.

limitations: Classification and loss were imported from the seed inventory and await review.
